# Fal API

> Reverse-engineered internal API. Unofficial — may change without notice.

## Documentation Index
- `SKILL.md` (this file)
- `references/REFERENCE.md` (detailed endpoint docs)
- `references/ENDPOINTS.json` (machine-readable endpoint catalog)
- `scripts/api.ts` (typed client interface)

## Authentication
Custom Header (x-write-key) — Authentication method detected from captured traffic.

### Providing credentials
- Prefer passing auth as request headers or cookies at call time (do not hardcode secrets into the skill).
- If executing via an external proxy/executor, pass per-call credentials (cookies and/or headers) so they are not persisted.

## Dependencies
- Runtime capable of HTTPS requests.
- If using `scripts/api.ts`: TypeScript toolchain (or transpile to JS).

## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (1)
- `GET /api/auth/v2/connect/{connectId}` — Complete an authentication flow using a connect ID.

### Data Read (11)
- `GET /{id}` — Retrieve data associated with a specific ID.
- `GET /api/trpc/pricing.getEnterpriseStatus` — Check the enterprise pricing status.
- `GET /customer-case/{customer-caseId}` — Retrieve data for a specific customer case.
- `GET /explore/{exploreId}` — Retrieve data for a specific explore item.
- `GET /models/fal-ai/{fal-aiId}/{fal-aiId}` — Get data related to a specific fal-ai model instance.
- `GET /models/fal-ai/flux-2-flex` — Retrieve data for the flux-2-flex model.
- `GET /models/fal-ai/nano-banana-pro/edit` — Get editable parameters for the nano-banana-pro model.
- `GET /models/fal-ai/veo3.1/reference-to-video` — Get reference video details for the veo3.1 model.
- `GET /models/xai/grok-imagine-image` — Retrieve data for the grok-imagine-image model.
- `GET /models/xai/grok-imagine-image/{grok-imagine-imageId}` — Get details about a specific Grok Imagine image.
- `GET /models/xai/grok-imagine-video/{grok-imagine-videoId}` — Get details about a specific Grok Imagine video.

### Data Write (1)
- `POST /analytics/v1/page` — Record a page view event for analytics.

### Media (7)
- `GET /_next/image` — Retrieve an image from the _next image service.
- `GET /models/fal-ai/{fal-aiId}/image-to-video/{image-to-videoId}` — Retrieve a specific image-to-video result.
- `GET /models/fal-ai/kling-video/o3/standard/image-to-video` — Access the image-to-video endpoint for kling-video o3 standard.
- `GET /models/fal-ai/kling-video/o3/standard/image-to-video/api` — Get the API definition for kling-video o3 standard image-to-video.
- `GET /models/fal-ai/kling-video/v3/pro/image-to-video` — Access the image-to-video endpoint for kling-video v3 pro.
- `GET /models/fal-ai/kling-video/v3/pro/image-to-video/api` — Get the API definition for kling-video v3 pro image-to-video.
- `GET /models/fal-ai/ltx-2-19b/image-to-video` — Get the image-to-video output from the ltx-2-19b model.

### Core API (6)
- `GET /models/fal-ai/flux-pro/kontext/{kontextId}` — Retrieve a specific kontext result from flux-pro.
- `GET /models/fal-ai/nano-banana-pro/edit/api` — Get the API definition for the nano-banana-pro model.
- `GET /models/fal-ai/veo3.1/reference-to-video/api` — Get the API definition for the veo3.1 model.
- `GET /models/fal-ai/wan-25-preview/text-to-video/{text-to-videoId}` — Retrieve a specific text-to-video result from wan-25-preview.
- `GET /models/xai/grok-imagine-image/edit/api` — Get the API definition for the grok-imagine-image model.
- `GET /models/xai/grok-imagine-video/{grok-imagine-videoId}/api` — Get the API definition for a specific grok-imagine-video.

## Quick Start

### OpenClaw (Unbrowse) workflow
- Authenticate in the browser first (no credentials are shipped with this skill).
- Capture fresh auth locally: run `unbrowse_capture` on an authenticated page for this domain.
- Execute via backend gate + client browser executor: `unbrowse_replay` with `executionMode="backend"`.

Example:
```text
unbrowse_replay { service: "fal", executionMode: "backend", endpoint: "GET /{id}" }
```

Here are a few examples to get you started with the fal API. These examples assume you have a `client` object initialized with the necessary authentication.

```typescript
// Retrieve details for a specific Grok Imagine image.
async function getGrokImageDetails(imageId: string) {
  try {
    const imageDetails = await client.models.xai.grokImagineImage[imageId]();
    console.log("Grok Imagine Image Details:", imageDetails);
    return imageDetails;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error fetching image details:", error);
    return null;
  }
}

const imageId = "some-image-id";
getGrokImageDetails(imageId);
```

```typescript
// Retrieve the API definition for the nano-banana-pro model.
async function getNanoBananaProApiDefinition() {
  try {
    const apiDefinition = await client.models.falAi.nanoBananaPro.edit.api();
    console.log("Nano Banana Pro API Definition:", apiDefinition);
    return apiDefinition;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error fetching API definition:", error);
    return null;
  }
}

getNanoBananaProApiDefinition();
```

```typescript
// Record a page view event for analytics.
async function recordPageView(pageUrl: string) {
  try {
    const response = await client.analytics.v1.page({
      url: pageUrl,
      // Add other relevant data as needed
    });
    console.log("Page view recorded:", response);
    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error recording page view:", error);
    return null;
  }
}

const currentPageUrl = "https://example.com/some-page";
recordPageView(currentPageUrl);
```

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Fal's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Fal data without official API access
- Automate actions on fal.ai (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Fal frontend uses

## Quick Start

```typescript
import { FalClient } from "./scripts/api.ts";

// Load captured auth from auth.json
const client = await FalClient.fromAuthFile("auth.json");

// Make requests to internal endpoints
const result = await client.get("/endpoint");
```

## Captured Authentication

The `auth.json` file contains credentials extracted from browser traffic:
- **Auth headers:** 2 (sec-fetch-storage-access, x-write-key)
- **Session cookies:** 25

If auth expires, re-run `unbrowse_login` or `unbrowse_capture` to refresh tokens.

```typescript
try {
  const data = await client.get("/resource");

    // Auth expired — need to re-capture
    console.error("Auth expired, re-run unbrowse_login");

    console.error("API error:", err.message);
  }
}
```
